Your goal for this game is: Make the tulacy enerk, the menny soriced and the ortid alism.

Once you have achieved your goal, write "> done" to end the game.

You are in a catint now. There are a rist, a menny, a pacia, a sioust, a ortid and a unflued. There is a passage to a penol here.

Instead of trying these unique verbs, I stuck to common actions like "hand," "give," and "use" which the game rejected. I also failed to explore the environment to find the correct locations for the "menny" and "ortid" mentioned in the goal. Next time, I will first explore the room to identify the exact names of the objects and characters, then strictly use the unique verbs (e.g., latory, tedne, derman, tuate, chross, sulphy) to interact with them, rather than guessing common verbs.
